title: Spectral Vision Transformer for Efficient Tokenization with Limited Data
abstract: arXiv:2605.12026v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision transformers tokenize an image into patches, which couples the token count to resolution and requires the embedding to be learned from data. We propose a spectral vision transformer architecture for efficient tokenization in the limited-data regime, with an emphasis on medical imaging. Rather than using spatial patches, we tokenize into coefficients of a fixed basis. This approach defines each token as one spectral mode, and the sequence length is chosen rather than implied by resolution, reducing the cost of attention. Our proposed spectral ViT shows superior or comparable performance where data is scarce in public medical imaging benchmarks, natural images, object shapes, simulations, and protected clinical data. We release our code at: https://github.com/agr78/SpectralViT.

translated_title: 面向有限数据高效标记化的频谱视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer将图像标记化为图像块，这使得标记数量与分辨率耦合，且需要从数据中学习嵌入。我们提出了一种频谱视觉Transformer架构，用于在有限数据条件下实现高效标记化，重点面向医学影像领域。不同于使用空间图像块，我们将图像标记化为固定基底的系数。这种方法将每个标记定义为一个频谱模态，序列长度可以自由选择而非由分辨率隐式决定，从而降低了注意力机制的计算成本。我们提出的频谱ViT在数据稀缺的场景下，于公开医学影像基准、自然图像、物体形状、仿真数据以及受保护的临床数据上均展现出优于或相当的性能。我们在以下网址开源了代码：https://github.com/agr78/SpectralViT。
tldr: 提出频谱视觉Transformer，将图像标记化为固定基底的频谱系数而非空间图像块，使序列长度与分辨率解耦、可自由选择，从而在数据稀缺场景（尤其是医学影像）下实现高效且性能优越的标记化。
en_tdlr: Proposes a spectral Vision Transformer that tokenizes images into coefficients of a fixed basis instead of spatial patches, making sequence length selectable and decoupled from resolution, thereby achieving efficient and superior tokenization in limited-data regimes, particularly for medical imaging.
